name: GAIP
one_liner: GAIP keeps an independent, dated record of what AI agents, MCP servers and online shops publish.
lead: GAIP, the Governed Agentic Intelligence Platform, keeps an independent, dated record of what AI agents, MCP servers and online shops publish, and answers questions about that record with signed receipts. Free, read-only, no key; facts at a stated time, never an assessment.
lead_then: A call failed? Paste the error into gaip_diagnose for the cause, retry timing and the exact fix.
short_description: GAIP, the Governed Agentic Intelligence Platform, keeps an independent, dated record of what AI agents, MCP servers and online shops publish, and answers questions about that record with signed receipts. Free, read-only, no key; facts at a stated time, never an assessment.
long_description: GAIP, the Governed Agentic Intelligence Platform, keeps an independent, dated record of what AI agents, MCP servers and online shops publish, and answers questions about that record with signed receipts. Free, read-only, no key; facts at a stated time, never an assessment. Start with gaip_check: give it the URL of an AI agent, MCP server or API and it says whether it works, whether its declaration is valid and what changed, with a receipt. A call failed? gaip_diagnose gives the cause and the fix. Everything else GAIP answers, grouped by who asks, is on the map: https://www.gaipagents.com/v1/free/map. Every completed answer carries a continuity handle; send it back and the answer is bound to your own history with GAIP. Every answer states what was observed and when; it is not a certification, endorsement, ranking or universal score, and not legal, financial or insurance advice. Calls are free and need no account or key; public or non-personal data only.

front_door_tools.name: gaip_check
front_door_tools.title: Check an AI agent, MCP server or API
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works or has changed, e.g. before adding or paying it. Pass its `url`. Returns a verdict, fixes, dated history when observed, and a receipt. With `agent` (e.g. GPTBot): may your bot fetch it (robots.txt, AI-crawler rules)?

front_door_tools.name: gaip_watch
front_door_tools.title: Watch an agent or MCP server for changes
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked to keep an eye on an agent or MCP server, or to be alerted when it changes. Pass its `url`: returns feed links and its latest dated changes; add `webhook_url` for a free watch (checked every 24 h, signed webhook on change).

front_door_tools.name: gaip_diagnose
front_door_tools.title: Why did my agent or API call fail?
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when an agent, MCP or API call failed. Paste the `error` text and/or `http_status`; add the service `url` if known. Returns the cause, the exact fix (e.g. the missing argument) and retry_after_seconds; `keep_receipt: true` adds a dated receipt.

front_door_tools.name: gaip_verify
front_door_tools.title: Verify a delivery or citations
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked whether a service delivered what was promised or whether cited pages contain the quoted text. Pass `citations`, or a service `url` (+ `checks`, the `result` you got), or `claims` with `observations`. Returns a result per item and a receipt.

front_door_tools.name: second_look_check
front_door_tools.title: Second Look: check before you buy
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when a shopper is about to buy something an AI suggested, or asks if a price or stock claim is right. Pass the product page `url` and the `claim`. Returns what the shop shows now, whether it matches, and a signed, dated receipt. Second Look by GAIP.

products.name: Check and GAIP Watch
products.question: Does this agent, server or API work, and has it changed?
products.one_line: A one-line verdict, the fixes, dated history where GAIP observes it, and a receipt; GAIP Watch follows it for changes.

products.name: Diagnose
products.question: A call failed; what went wrong?
products.one_line: The cause, when to retry and the exact fix, from the error text and HTTP status you paste.

products.name: Witness
products.question: Was this delivery or quotation what was promised?
products.one_line: Witness tests a service's response against the terms you registered, or cited pages against the quoted text, with a receipt for each.

products.name: The record by date
products.question: What did a site allow, publish, key or charge on a date?
products.one_line: Its robots.txt permissions for a named AI agent, its signing keys and its x402 prices in the week of that date; since when GAIP has recorded an endpoint or a registry name, and which earlier names look like it.

products.name: Notices
products.question: Has anyone withdrawn it or warned about it?
products.one_line: Registry status flips, an operator's own withdrawal, package advisories, each with the issuer named and the operator's reply.

products.name: Preferences
products.question: May I contact this person's agent?
products.one_line: Before an agent approaches a person it checks their published rules and keeps a receipt.

products.name: Deals
products.question: Was this business deal kept?
products.one_line: Both trading agents name GAIP as witness; either party asks for the signed finding on the agreed rule, over GAIP's own delivery records. Evidence, never a sum of money.

products.name: The caller screen
products.question: Who is calling me, and should I pick up?
products.one_line: When an agent approaches yours, the caller screen shows how long it has been on record and whether it checked first. Facts, never a score; GAIP cannot block a call.

products.name: Second Look
products.question: Does the shop's own page show the price and stock an AI quoted?
products.one_line: Second Look reads the shop's own page now and says whether it matches, with a signed, dated receipt. No affiliate links.

products.name: Mandates
products.question: Was this agent authorised to act for them?
products.one_line: Whether a person's published mandate for an agent was in force, withdrawn or expired as GAIP indexed it, with a receipt.

products.name: Sign-offs
products.question: Who signed off on this decision, and when?
products.one_line: A role records its decision on an agent's proposal, chained and signed; GAIP never takes the decision.

products.name: Ingredients and Residence
products.question: What is this agent made of, and where does it live?
products.one_line: As recorded on a date: what its documents say it runs on, and where it answered from (network and country, never the address).

products.name: Statements
products.question: What did my agents do this month?
products.one_line: A signed monthly record of what GAIP recorded for the agents bound to your continuity handle, with every line's receipt; served only to that handle.

agents.name: GAIP Integration & Protocol Agent
agents.one_liner: Behind /mcp: checks A2A, MCP and OpenAPI, keeps the Agent Observatory, diagnoses failed calls.

agents.name: GAIP Witness Agent
agents.one_liner: Agreed terms, delivery, receipts, disputes and evidence: what a service delivered, checkable later.

agents.name: GAIP Listing Observer
agents.one_liner: Shop listing data (preview): a product page as clean data, with source checks and price history.

claude_code.command: claude mcp add --transport http gaip https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp

claude_desktop.how: Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector (older versions: Settings > Connectors), enter the MCP URL and choose no sign-in.

chatgpt.how: Settings > Security and login > turn on Developer mode; then add a plugin with the plus button and, under Connection, enter the MCP URL (including /mcp).

openai_agents_sdk.python:
import asyncio
from agents import Agent, Runner
from agents.mcp import MCPServerStreamableHttp


async def main():
    async with MCPServerStreamableHttp(name='gaip', params={"url": 'https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp'}) as server:
        agent = Agent(name="Assistant", instructions="Use the GAIP tools to check agents.",
                      mcp_servers=[server])
        result = await Runner.run(agent, "Check https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp with gaip_check.")
        print(result.final_output)


asyncio.run(main())
openai_agents_sdk.hosted_python:
from agents import Agent, HostedMCPTool, Runner

agent = Agent(name="Assistant", tools=[HostedMCPTool(tool_config={
    "type": "mcp", "server_label": 'gaip', "server_url": 'https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp', "require_approval": "never"})])
print(Runner.run_sync(agent, "Check https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp with gaip_check.").final_output)

import asyncio
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient

    client = MultiServerMCPClient({'gaip': {"transport": "http", "url": 'https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp'}})
    tools = await client.get_tools()
    print([tool.name for tool in tools])


asyncio.run(main())

wording_rules: Describe GAIP as read-only evidence about what was observed at a stated time.
Do not describe GAIP or any agent it checks as certified, endorsed, ranked or scored.
Do not state prices, customers, users or adoption figures.
Link the terms, privacy, corrections and methodology pages (drafts pending legal review).
